analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md changed (documentation). The patch adds one 'Unreleased - machine model diagnostics' entry at lines 3-5 of head. It describes extending the authenticated admin machine view with per-session reported pins, resident models, hardware, snapshot freshness and the running provider's Always ready/idle-timeout configuration. The entry says these diagnostics are read-only, keep unknown distinct from empty or disabled, and do not activate Autopilot, change pins or idle policy, or guarantee ready capacity. The code implementing this is not in the supplied diff, so the claims cannot be checked here.

Security relevance (not findings): the entry concerns admin-only exposure of provider-reported data. Relevant boundaries are TB-006 (admin to coordinator) and TB-002, where provider-reported fields are untrusted and unsigned and must not be treated as authorization or trust evidence (T-052, T-056). Provider-reported hardware and model residency are adversary-controlled input. If the admin UI or API renders them, a later pass should check for output sanitization and that the data is not used for routing or billing decisions. The data also adds no identifiers beyond what the admin view already exposes. Possible links to T-051 and T-058 (identity leakage through admin exports and diagnostics) apply only if the implementing code is changed in a separate PR.

No code, config, workflow or threat-model files changed. No threat assumption is invalidated. Integration should confirm that no companion source change exists in this batch that exposes new fields to non-admin callers.
